identity: Gruul landfall burn-aggro. Lander tokens turn spare mana into extra land-ETBs at instant speed, and Tannuk, Memorial Ensign converts each land-ETB into 1 damage to each opponent plus a card on the second trigger each turn. Biotech Specialist adds 2 more damage every time an artifact is sacrificed, and cracking a Lander is exactly that, so one {2} activation is 3 damage with no attack step. Weftstalker Ardent widens the same rail to creatures and artifacts entering, and the combat half is carried by Remnant Elemental, Nova Hellkite and Eusocial Engineering's Robot tokens, all scaling off the same triggers.
